legal_access.note: Not assessed. Are approvals, data rights and project scope valid?

secure_environment.note: Not assessed. Are authorized storage, compute, access and retention defined?

privacy_disclosure.note: Not assessed. Are outputs, small cells and participant-level exports controlled?

stakeholder_question.note: Not assessed. Is the actual research/clinical question and intended user defined?

population_sampling.note: Not assessed. Are source population, selection, eligibility and nonparticipation characterized?

provenance_versions.note: Not assessed. Are raw source, transformations, checksums and dictionary tracked?

data_integrity.note: Not assessed. Have types, duplicates, ranges, units, joins and impossible values been checked?

missingness_mechanisms.note: Not assessed. Are skips, nonresponse, unavailable values and codebook semantics distinguished?

wave_site_harmonization.note: Not assessed. Are instruments/units/definitions compatible across waves and sites?

outcome_index_horizon.note: Not assessed. Are prediction time, outcome, horizon and availability precisely defined?

followup_censoring.note: Not assessed. Are censoring, competing risks and outcome ascertainment addressed?

observation_grain.note: Not assessed. Are repeated visits, family/site groups and event dependence recognized?

predictor_availability.note: Not assessed. Are all candidate predictors known at prediction time?

leakage_prevention.note: Not assessed. Are IDs, proxies, transformations and tuning isolated from evaluation?

splits_and_holdout.note: Not assessed. Are group/time/site splits and holdout reuse history recorded?

missingness_processing.note: Not assessed. Are imputations/indicators/categories source-aware and learned inside folds?

candidate_models.note: Not assessed. Are simple benchmarks and task-appropriate models compared fairly?

tuning_and_reproducibility.note: Not assessed. Are selection, CV, random seeds and computational budgets reproducible?

class_imbalance_sample_size.note: Not assessed. Are prevalence, event counts, power and effective sample size considered?

survey_and_cluster_design.note: Not assessed. Are weights, PSUs, strata, site clustering and estimands handled if relevant?

discrimination_and_error.note: Not assessed. Are task-appropriate discrimination and error scores planned?

calibration_and_proper_scores.note: Not assessed. Are calibration and proper scores evaluated without leakage?

clinical_decision_utility.note: Not assessed. Are thresholds, harms, net benefit and use-case value justified?

uncertainty_and_robustness.note: Not assessed. Are intervals, sensitivity and model selection uncertainty handled?

subgroups_fairness.note: Not assessed. Are subgroup sample sizes, heterogeneity and equity assessed safely?

external_transportability.note: Not assessed. Is a genuinely independent transport/temporal/site evaluation planned?

transparent_reporting.note: Not assessed. Are TRIPOD+AI and other study-specific reporting items planned?

bias_applicability.note: Not assessed. Are PROBAST+AI risk of bias and applicability reviewed separately?

figures_reproducibility.note: Not assessed. Are cohort flow, calibration, performance and versioned artifacts reproducible?

limitations_communication.note: Not assessed. Are exploration, perturbed labels and intended-use limits explicit?

deployment_scope.note: Not assessed. Is there a clear no-deployment or approved deployment boundary?

drift_monitoring.note: Not assessed. Is a monitoring, updating and incident plan needed and defined?

handoff_and_ownership.note: Not assessed. Are analyst, PI, custodian and approver roles assigned?
